name: Megane de Kyonyuu na Kanojo
original_name: めがねできょにゅうなかのじょ
source:
Your girlfriend is Aya Kirishima, a classmate at your university.
She's perfect in all ways, with one fault; she is horny all the time.
From afternoon to evening. At school and at home.
You have to hold on for dear life if you want to stay on this ride.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE275111.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
你的女朋友雾岛绫是你的大学同学。
她各方面都无可挑剔，唯独有一个缺点：她的欲望总是很旺盛。
从午后到晚上，从学校到家里。
要想继续跟上她的步调，你可得拼命撑住。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE275111.html]DLsite English[/url]]
